name: abcde
description: abcde rips audio CDs end-to-end: reads the disc with cdparanoia, fetches track metadata from CDDB/MusicBrainz, encodes to FLAC/MP3/Ogg Vorbis/Opus/AAC/WAV, tags and names files, and cleans up - all driven by flags or a ~/.abcde.conf config.

install_steps: sudo apt-get install -y abcde cdparanoia flac lame vorbis-tools

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install abcde: sudo apt-get install -y abcde cdparanoia

commands.description: Rip the audio CD in the drive (abcde -o flac; pass track numbers/flags as needed)
